items.description: An editor for a breakpoint ramp, such as an ADSR shape or an automation curve.
items.name: envelope

items.description: A track's automation over its lane in a timeline: an envelope along the whole arrangement, under the same zoom and scroll as the clips, whose line and points alone take the pointer.
items.name: automation-envelope

items.description: A clip of an arrangement on its track's lane: move it, trim and fade it, pick a fade's curve, rename it in place and act on it from its menu. A MIDI clip draws its notes across its body.
items.name: arranged-clip

items.description: Locators and time-signature changes on a timeline's lane: press one to jump there, rename or retype it in place, move a signature with the arrows, delete either.
items.name: timeline-markers

items.description: A track's automation: a chooser of the parameter its lane shows, Volume or Pan, for its header, and that parameter's envelope over its lane, standing faint at the mix's value until it is drawn.
items.name: track-automation

items.description: A rotary control for continuous parameters, with pointer, wheel and keyboard input.
items.name: knob

items.description: A linear slider for gain and other continuous parameters.
items.name: fader

items.description: A two-dimensional control for two parameters at once, with pointer, wheel and keyboard input.
items.name: xypad

items.description: A grid of drum pads struck by pointer, touch or keyboard, with velocity and choke groups.
items.name: pad

items.description: A piano keyboard for a MIDI pitch range, played with the pointer, touch or the keyboard.
items.name: piano

items.description: A note editor on a grid: draw, move, resize and select notes, with a playable keyboard and a velocity lane.
items.name: piano-roll

items.description: A menu that picks a root and a scale and turns the scale on or off, in parts you place, beside items of your own.
items.name: scale-menu

items.description: Finds notes by what they are: a pitch, ranges of velocity, length and chance, in or out of the scale, active or not, every few, or the rest. A form, or the form in a popover.
items.name: note-find

items.description: A menu of commands over a piano roll's notes (split, join, quantize, legato, time commands, fit to scale, chance, velocity), with their keys: items and submenus you place, beside items of your own. The commands come as data in lib/note-edits, to run from keys or a toolbar too.
items.name: note-edit-menu

items.description: The note and the pitch of a sound, live from the microphone, with a needle on a scale of cents.
items.name: tuner

items.description: A panel for any device: a knob per number and a toggle per switch, from its descriptors, controlled by a state a host owns.
items.name: device-panel

items.description: The face of the compressor device: the transfer curve it plays, with the threshold and the level going in on it, over the device's knobs.
items.name: compressor-panel

items.description: The face of the Pocket Synth device: a pad that plays it, its waveform and filter, and its volume. Controlled, with the notes leaving through onNoteOn and onNoteOff.
items.name: pocket-synth-panel

items.description: A row of buttons, one per waveform, each drawn as its shape: pick one. Fed by the options of a device's choice parameter.
items.name: waveform-select

items.description: A row of buttons, one per filter type, each drawn as the response it has: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, notch, low and high cut, low and high shelf, bell. Fed by the options of a device's choice parameter.
items.name: filter-type-select

items.description: A row of buttons, one per transfer curve, each drawn from the curve itself: you give it the function of each option, so the icon is what the device does and never drifts from it.
items.name: curve-select

items.description: A play and pause button for a demo signal: the icon follows the state, the name says what pressing it does.
items.name: play-toggle

items.description: The face of the Wave Shaper device: a pad that plays it, its waveform and its knobs. Controlled, with the notes leaving through onNoteOn and onNoteOff.
items.name: wave-shaper-panel

items.description: The face of the delay device: the echoes it makes, one line each and fainter as they fade, with a handle on the first to drag its time and feedback, over the device's knobs.
items.name: delay-panel

items.description: The face of the reverb device: the tail it makes, its level falling to -60 dB, with a handle where it ends to drag the decay time, over the device knobs.
items.name: reverb-panel

items.description: The face of the filter device: the curve it plays with a handle on the cutoff to drag its frequency and resonance, an optional live spectrum behind it, over the device knobs.
items.name: filter-panel

items.description: The face of the distortion device: its transfer curve against the straight line of a clean sound, over the device knobs.
items.name: distortion-panel

items.description: The face of the chorus device: the delay time as the oscillator sweeps it over two seconds, over the device knobs.
items.name: chorus-panel

items.description: The face of the utility device: its gain, pan and width as knobs and its mono and invert switches.
items.name: utility-panel

items.description: The face of the limiter device: its transfer curve against the straight line of a clean sound with a handle for the ceiling and the input gain, over the device knobs.
items.name: limiter-panel

items.description: The face of the gate device: its transfer curve against the straight line of a clean sound with a handle on the threshold, over the device knobs.
items.name: gate-panel

items.description: The face of the saturator device: its transfer curve against the straight line of a clean sound, over the device knobs and the choice of curve.
items.name: saturator-panel

items.description: The face of the phaser-flanger device: the sweep of its oscillator over two seconds, over the device knobs, with the ones the mode does not use drawn off.
items.name: phaser-panel

items.description: The face of the auto pan device: what the oscillator does to the pan or the level over two seconds, over the device knobs.
items.name: auto-pan-panel

items.description: The face of the channel EQ device: the curve it plays with a handle on the mid band and an optional live spectrum, over the shelf knobs and the high-pass switch.
items.name: channel-eq-panel

items.description: The face of the overdrive device: the band that reaches the clip with a handle on its centre, over the device knobs.
items.name: overdrive-panel

items.description: The face of the de-esser device: what it does at each frequency with a handle at the frequency to drag across and up or down for the range, over the device knobs.
items.name: deesser-panel

items.description: The face of the multiband compressor device: the three bands drawn against frequency with a handle on each split, over the knobs of each band.
items.name: multiband-panel

items.description: The face of the transient shaper device: a square with the sustain across and the attack up, and a handle to drag to both at once, over the output knob.
items.name: transient-panel

items.description: The face of the mid/side device: a square with the side level across and the mid level up, and a handle to drag to both at once, over the bass mono knob.
items.name: mid-side-panel

items.description: The face of the redux device: the stairs the bits make against the straight line of a clean sound, over the device knobs.
items.name: redux-panel

items.description: The face of the equalizer device: the curve it plays with a handle on each band to drag its frequency and gain, an optional live spectrum behind it, over the device's knobs gathered by band.
items.name: equalizer-panel

items.description: The level of a sound across frequencies, live, on a log axis in hertz, with held peaks.
items.name: spectrum-analyzer

items.description: Curves and draggable points, for equalizers, filters and compressors.
items.name: plot

items.description: A level meter in decibels for one or more channels, with peak hold.
items.name: meter

items.description: A needle meter: a dial in dB that a live level moves, with the VU or the PPM ballistics of @audio-ui/core/meter. The needle turns outside React, so the dial does not re-render with the signal.

items.description: Draws audio: a seekable waveform with regions and markers, a live waveform that scrolls with the signal, and a bar visualizer.

items.description: The clip view of an arrangement's audio clip: a strip with its switch and name that rolls the view up, then Clip (start, end), Loop (switch, position, length, ÷2, ×2) and Sample (Warp, Reverse, Crop, Gain, Transpose, speed) boxes in bars.beats.16ths, the last two foldable, beside its source on a timeline of its own (overview, bar ruler, the stretch it plays or loops to drag, warp markers on the waveform).

items.description: The clip view of an arrangement's MIDI clip: a strip with its switch and name that rolls the view up, then Clip (start, end), Loop (switch, position, length, ÷2, ×2, Dupl. Loop) and Notes (transpose, invert, reverse, legato, ×2, ÷2, humanize, velocity ramps) boxes, the last two foldable, beside its piano roll (Draw, Fold, the loop brace on the ruler, keys, grid, a velocity or chance lane). items.description: A zoomable timeline for arrangement views and editors, with a ruler that seeks, lanes and a playhead.

items.description: A tempo field on its own: type it, step it with the arrows, or drag its unit to scrub the value.

items.name: use-simulated-clock

items.description: A selection rectangle for the clips of a timeline: drag across bare lane (with Shift, or in a multi-select mode) and the clips it touches join the selection

items.description: Undo and redo over a value you own: an edit made in one go, or a gesture that undoes as one.

items.description: The microphone as an AnalyserNode on the shared AudioContext: raw signal, never connected to the speakers, released on stop and on unmount

items.description: The live levels of a signal from its AnalyserNodes, in the shape a Meter paints from: RMS in dB per channel with a peak that holds and falls, refreshed every frame without re-rendering

items.description: Levels that move on their own, with a peak that holds and falls, in the shape a Meter paints from: a demo meter that is never at rest
items.name: use-simulated-levels

items.description: The spectrum of an AnalyserNode as a live source for Plot.Trace: dB per point on a logarithmic frequency axis, refreshed every frame without re-rendering, and its held peaks as a second source

Draw or select notes, mark a scale and fold onto it, undo and redo, and edit the selection from the Notes menu: split at the playhead, chop, join, legato, reverse, invert, stretch, fit to scale, crescendo and humanize. items.description: The compressor as a device: its parameters and what they mean, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: compressor-device

items.description: A compressor on the Web Audio API for a compressor state: the node, its make-up taken back out or kept, a dry and compressed mix aligned to the node's lookahead, parameters that move without a click, and a key: a worklet detector that ducks the signal from another one.
items.name: compressor-engine

items.description: The Pocket Synth as an instrument device: its waveform, filter and volume, and the pitch and filter cutoff a position on a pad plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: pocket-synth-device

items.description: A monophonic synth on the Web Audio API for a Pocket Synth state: noteOn starts a note or glides the held one, noteOff releases it, and the wave, filter and volume follow the state without a click.
items.name: pocket-synth-engine

items.description: The Wave Shaper as an instrument device: its waveform, drive, tone, detune, mix and volume, the pitch and resonance a pad position plays, and the distortion curve, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: wave-shaper-device

items.description: A wave shaper synth on the Web Audio API for a Wave Shaper state: two detuned oscillators, a distortion mixed in parallel and a low-pass filter; noteOn starts a note or glides the held one, noteOff releases it.
items.name: wave-shaper-engine

items.description: The delay as a device: its time, feedback, tone and mix, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the echoes a state makes, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: delay-device

items.description: A delay on the Web Audio API for a delay state: an echo that goes round a tone filter so each repeat is darker, mixed with the dry sound, with a time that bends like a tape instead of clicking.
items.name: delay-engine

items.description: The reverb as a device: its decay, pre-delay, damping and mix, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the decay a state draws and the impulse response of its room, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: reverb-device

items.description: A reverb on the Web Audio API for a reverb state: a convolver fed a room made from the decay and the damping, two of them cross-faded so a new room never clicks, after a pre-delay and mixed with the dry sound.
items.name: reverb-engine

items.description: The filter as a device: a type, a cutoff and a resonance, the numbers that go on the node for a state and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: filter-device

items.description: A filter on the Web Audio API for a filter state: the node the curve draws, with the resonance in the unit it wants, and the signal going round it when it is off, moving without a click.
items.name: filter-engine

items.description: The distortion as a device: a drive, a tone, a mix and an output level, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the soft clip and the transfer curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: distortion-device

items.description: A distortion on the Web Audio API for a distortion state: a drive gain into a fixed soft-clip table at 4x oversampling, a tone filter, mixed with the clean sound at an output level, moving without a click.
items.name: distortion-engine

items.description: The chorus as a device: a rate, a depth, a delay and a mix, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the sweep of the delay time, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: chorus-device

items.description: A chorus on the Web Audio API for a chorus state: a short delay whose time an oscillator sweeps, mixed with the dry sound, moving without a click.
items.name: chorus-engine

items.description: The utility as a device: a gain, a pan, a stereo width, a mono switch and a phase invert, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: utility-device

items.description: A utility on the Web Audio API for a utility state: the signal split into mid and side, the side scaled by the width, then a pan and a gain with an optional phase invert, moving without a click.
items.name: utility-engine

items.description: The limiter as a device: an input gain, a ceiling and a release, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: limiter-device

items.description: A limiter on the Web Audio API for a limiter state: the browser compressor node at a ratio of 20 with no knee, its make-up taken back out, the signal going round it when it is off.
items.name: limiter-engine

items.description: The gate as a device: a threshold, a floor, an attack, a hold, a release and a look-ahead, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the detector worklet and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: gate-device

items.description: A gate on the Web Audio API for a gate state: a worklet detector reads the key and writes the gain (threshold, attack, hold, release), and a delay in front of the gain gives the look-ahead.
items.name: gate-engine

items.description: The saturator as a device: a curve, a drive, a mix and an output level, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the four curves and the transfer curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: saturator-device

items.description: A saturator on the Web Audio API for a saturator state: a drive gain into the table of the chosen curve at 4x oversampling, mixed with the clean sound at an output level; the table is rebuilt only when the curve changes.
items.name: saturator-engine

items.description: The phaser-flanger as a device: a mode, a rate, a depth, a centre frequency, a delay, a feedback and a mix, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the sweep, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: phaser-device

items.description: A phaser and flanger on the Web Audio API for a phaser state: four all-pass filters and a short delay swept by one oscillator, crossfaded by the mode, with feedback and a mix.
items.name: phaser-engine

items.description: The auto pan as a device: a mode, a waveform, a rate and a depth, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the movement the oscillator makes, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: auto-pan-device

items.description: An auto pan and tremolo on the Web Audio API for an auto pan state: one oscillator that moves a stereo panner or the level of a gain, by the mode, at a rate, a depth and a waveform.
items.name: auto-pan-engine

items.description: The channel EQ as a device: a low shelf, a sweepable mid bell, a high shelf, a high-pass switch and an output level, their filters as a state describes them and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: channel-eq-device

items.description: A channel EQ on the Web Audio API for a channel EQ state: a high-pass, a low shelf, a mid bell and a high shelf in series with an output trim, the same filters its curve draws, moving without a click.
items.name: channel-eq-engine

items.description: The overdrive as a device: a band-pass before a soft clip with a drive, a tone and a mix, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the band that reaches the clip, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: overdrive-device

items.description: An overdrive on the Web Audio API for an overdrive state: a band-pass, a drive gain, a soft-clip table at 4x oversampling and a tone filter, mixed with the clean sound, moving without a click.
items.name: overdrive-engine

items.description: The de-esser as a device: a frequency, a threshold, a ratio and a range, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the table that keeps the highs above their floor and the response a state draws, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: deesser-device

items.description: A de-esser on the Web Audio API for a de-esser state: a Linkwitz-Riley split at the frequency, the highs read by the compressor's detector and taken down over the threshold, never under the range, and added back to the lows.
items.name: deesser-engine

items.description: The multiband compressor as a device: two splits and a threshold and ratio for each of the three bands, with an attack, a release and an output gain, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the bands a state draws, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: multiband-device

items.description: A multiband compressor on the Web Audio API for a multiband state: a Linkwitz-Riley split in three bands that add back flat, and for each band the compressor's detector driving its gain.
items.name: multiband-engine

items.description: The transient shaper as a device: an attack and a sustain, each up or down by 12 dB, and an output gain, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state and the source of the detector worklet, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: transient-device

items.description: A transient shaper on the Web Audio API for a transient state: a worklet detector reads the shape of the envelope and writes the gain, and the audio waits a millisecond for it so the attack is shaped from its first sample.
items.name: transient-engine

items.description: The mid/side device as a device: a level for the mid, a level for the side and a bass mono frequency, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: mid-side-device

items.description: A mid/side device on the Web Audio API for a mid/side state: the signal split into mid and side, a level for each, a high-pass on the side for bass mono, and the two added back, moving without a click.
items.name: mid-side-engine

items.description: The detector of a key: an AudioWorklet loaded once per context from a blob, which reads a signal and writes the gain a compressor would apply to it. The compressor's key and the de-esser use it.
items.name: key-detector

items.description: The redux as a device: a number of bits, a downsample factor and a mix, the numbers that go on the nodes for a state, the stairs of the quantizer and the source of the sample-hold worklet, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: redux-device

items.description: A redux on the Web Audio API for a redux state: a sample hold in an AudioWorklet loaded from a blob and a quantizer table for the bits, mixed with the clean sound; the bits are crushed at once and the hold joins when the worklet is ready.
items.name: redux-engine

items.description: Pink noise as an audio buffer: equal energy per octave, so a flat equalizer looks flat on a spectrum.
items.name: pink-noise

items.description: Measure an engine against what its device claims, in an offline audio context: how far its frequency response is from the curve the panel draws, how long it delays a signal, and the helpers to render and read a signal. For a host that brings its own engine.
items.name: device-measure

items.description: What a waveshaper that oversamples costs in time, and a delay that holds a dry path back by it, so a distortion mixed with its dry sound does not comb. Measured in Chrome.
items.name: oversampling

items.description: The rate of an oscillator that is either free, in hertz, or synced: one cycle per note value of the host's tempo. The two parameters a device adds for it, and the function that reads the rate.
items.name: synced-rate

items.description: A two-second loop to put an effect on: a kick and a snare, a hat on the eighths and a short line of plucked notes, drawn once from the drum voices of the library and looped as a buffer.
items.name: demo-loop

items.description: The equalizer as a device: a low shelf, two bells and a high shelf with an output trim, their filters as a state describes them, and the curve a state plays, with no panel and no audio in it.
items.name: equalizer-device

items.description: An equalizer on the Web Audio API for an equalizer state: four biquad filters in series with an output trim, the same filters its curve draws, moving without a click.
items.name: equalizer-engine

items.description: The document of an arrangement of clips on tracks: its clips, tracks and mixes, how far a clip reaches, where a MIDI clip's notes play, and what a track's volume and pan automation gives at a point of the song
items.name: arrangement

items.description: Undo and redo as a value: a pure history of any document, with bursts (a drag is one entry), redo that drops on a new change, and a depth limit
items.name: undo-history

items.description: MIDI files to and from notes on a grid of steps: read one, with its tempo, write one, or download one
items.name: midi-file

items.description: AI-native tool surface for a piano roll, createPianoRollTools builds typed, agent-agnostic tools (setNotes/addNotes/removeNotes/transpose/clear/setTempo) an LLM calls to compose melodies and basslines from natural language, parameterized by the roll's pitch range and grid
items.name: piano-roll-tools

items.description: One-shot percussion synthesis (kick, snare, hihat) built from oscillators and noise bursts, each with its own tune and decay
items.name: drum-synthesis
